objective: Proof of dopeness. Prove the format works before scaling anything.

concept.headline: A documented music party. Not a polished broadcast.
concept.body: Think Prince renting a room and just playing. AOL Sessions. MTV Unplugged. A small room, real artists, two sets that flow into each other, a podcast-room feed in between — and four cameras rolling so the night lives past the night. This isn't proof of concept. It's proof of dopeness: we're actually doing it, on our own. Ten die-hards over a hundred.
concept.note: Episode 01 · Monthly if it lands. Quarterly if the gear says otherwise.
